title: What he did in the winter when the shows closed
summary: Shows closed in winter; he sometimes came home to play with locals and sometimes stayed in the closing town.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Okay, that's good one man. You asked about the circuit, did they travel the south in the winter time and go up north in the summer? Or did they lay off part of the year?
Well in winter, they closed. Closed completely in winter. Well strictly summer shows.

Yep. Then from... Oh in between, sounds like I'm trying to butt into all your life details, but naturally you want to get as much of your history as possible. I wondered when the show would close down if you'd come back to New Orleans and play here in dance bands, or what did you do in the winter?
Sometime I did. Sometime I came back here and played with different fellas, and sometime I didn't. Sometime I stayed wherever the show closed. Stayed in that town and played with fellas there.
